svg.title: Observed station distributions
svg.desc: All 75 original selected values; the plot uses their measured concentration units. Boxes span the 25th–75th percentiles; center line = median; whiskers = observed minimum/maximum; diamond = mean. Each circle is one original sample. Horizontal offsets separate points and do not encode a variable. Quantiles use R-7. Source: original WQP CHLA activities and the retained explicit study-calendar/routine-overlap reconciliation.

svg.text: All 75 original selected values; the plot uses their measured concentration units.
Boxes span the 25th–75th percentiles; center line = median; whiskers = observed minimum/maximum; diamond = mean.
Each circle is one original sample. Horizontal offsets separate points and do not encode a variable. Quantiles use R-7.
Source: original WQP CHLA activities and the retained explicit study-calendar/routine-overlap reconciliation.
